title: Promotion Sustainable Practices using Eco-Friendly Idols
place: Needy Families identified in Swathantranagar & Faculty of College
description: We the club of WeR4Help along with some volunteers prepared eco-friendly Ganesha idols on the auspicious festival of Ganesh Chaturthi in our college premises. The idols are made with mud instead of non-biodegradable materials like plaster of Paris. By selling the Ganesha idols we collected fund which is used to provide essential support to underprivileged families. Volunteers preparing Eco-friendly idols

title: Visit to orphanage to bring happiness and joy among the children
description: We the club of WeR4Help along with some volunteers visited near by orphanage to spend time with children’s and also we provided the food for children’s and spend quality time with them by conducting games many more activities. And we also gave them the hand crafted materials like bands and bangles which are made by our volunteers with love. We felt very happy by spending with them and they too felt very happy with our arrival.

title: Distribution of Groceries to the Needy Families
description: we the club of WeR4Help along with some volunteers visited near-by place called Swatantranagar as per our report which is considered to be having the most number of people suffering from basic needs. So in order to support them we along with some volunteers visited various houses for selecting the needy ones. We have divided into groups and each group recorded 8 to 10 families and also requested them if any help can be done from our side.

title: Socio-Economic Survey to Identify the Needy Families
description: In a survey conducted by the team of WeR4Help. It was found that some of the residents in area of Swatantra Nagar, Madhurawada are very old, poor and are orphaned by their children and are not getting either pension or ration. We were surveyed nearly 50 families in which they have different families have different problems.Out of that we selected most underrated families.
